statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these neurological and vestibular symptoms.
Diagnoses documented as G45.9 and R42.
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197.
The denial was based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered.
This service is medically necessary to identify intermittent cardiac arrhythmias underlying the patient's transient cerebral ischemic attacks and symptomatic dizziness.
